steps.title: Factor Numerator and Denominator
steps.explanation: Apply difference of cubes to numerator and difference of squares to denominator.
steps.why: Difference of cubes identity: a^3 - b^3 = (a - b)(a^2 + ab + b^2).

steps.title: Cancel Common Factor (x - 1)
steps.explanation: Cancel the common factor (x - 1) which caused the 0/0 form.
steps.why: In limit evaluation, x approaches 1 but is never equal to 1.

steps.title: Evaluate Limit of Simplified Expression
steps.explanation: Substitute x = 1 into the simplified continuous rational function.
steps.why: Direct substitution is valid when denominator does not equal zero.
